text:
Samir Gupta: Quick flag  onboarding Cedar-7B (hf -> runtime) in int8. Short QA smoke shows long-context answers drop accuracy on our 50Q benchmark: fp16=78.6% -> int8=73.2%. Looks systematic after token 1024. Suspect rotary offset + tokenizer eos mapping.
Elena Voronova: can you share convert args and quant spec? also a canonical failing prompt?
Samir Gupta: convert: `python convert_hf.py --model cedar-7b --out /models/cedar-7b-int8 --quant int8 --perchannel --block 64`
quant spec: `int8, per-channel, rotate_baseline=auto, kv_shard=false`
prompt: multi-paragraph QA with long context (seed=7). repro in docker: runtime:release-2026-03
Kai Liu: rotate_baseline=auto often diverges between converter and runtime conventions. Try rotate_baseline=1.0 and also check special token ids mapping (our tokenizer sometimes remaps <|endoftext|> to a different id during conversion).
Samir Gupta: ran single-example trace: kv keys look same, but rotary cos/sin for head groups 4..7 show a phase offset starting at pos=1025.
Elena Voronova: phase offset at rollover suggests token ID wrap/offset in tokenizer or a mismatched pos embedding start index. Did conversion log token_count or store tokenizer.json?
Samir Gupta: converter wrote tokenizer.json, but tokenizer.offset was 0. runtime reported tokenizer.offset=1 in logs. So mismatch.
Kai Liu: that would shift rotary application by one and cause the long-context drift. Two options: re-generate model with tokenizer.offset=1 or adjust runtime to respect converter tokenizer metadata. Short-term: convert again forcing rotate_baseline=0.5 and explicitly write tokenizer.offset=1 into the model bundle.
Samir Gupta: I'll re-run conversion with explicit flags and rerun the 50Q eval.
ci-bot: job queued: quant-longctx-cedar-5267894321 (artifacts -> s3://ci/cedar/5267894321/)
Samir Gupta: quick update: re-convert with tokenizer.offset=1 + rotate_baseline=0.5 improved accuracy to 76.9%. Still not fp16 but much closer.
Elena Voronova: good. We should add a converter check that validator-asserts tokenizer.offset matches runtime reported value. Also emit a posmap.json for future.
Kai Liu: I'll add a small runtime guard to log a warning when tokenizer.offset differs between model bundle and runtime tokenizer. Also add a headgroup phase-diff probe tool.
Samir Gupta: filing GH issue #1498 with logs, s3 artifacts, and the failing prompt. Will run full 500Q regression if PRs land.
ops-bot: deploy alert: staging cluster deployed release-2026-03-05 with Cedar-7B-int8 (canary=1)
Samir Gupta: thanks team. leaving int8 canary on until full regression passes.
